about.story_heading: A campus home for Muslim students
about.story_text: MSiS began as a student initiative to give Muslim students at UiS a supportive environment. Today we work for faith-informed student life through programmes, advocacy and collaboration.
about.glance_text: We are a non-commercial, politically independent organisation. Everything we do is governed by our members and rooted in the core values of Islam: compassion, knowledge and community care.
about.purpose_text: Our aim is to support Muslim students spiritually, academically and socially — and to build bridges of understanding across the whole student community.
about.constitution_mission: Promote unity, learning and dialogue among Muslim students at UiS.
about.constitution_membership: Open and free to all students who share our values.
about.constitution_governance: Democratically led by an elected board and an annual general assembly.
about.collab_text: We work closely with UiS, SiS and StOr to ensure Muslim students' voices are heard in decisions that shape campus life.

prayer.tips_method: Times are sourced from Mawaqeet Norge, calculated for Stavanger.
prayer.tips_wudu: Remember wudu before prayer — facilities are available by the prayer room.
prayer.reminders_friday: Friday prayer (Juma) is announced weekly via Instagram and email.
prayer.reminders_spaces: The prayer room in Kjølv Egeland's building and room Ø-110 are open to all students.
prayer.extreme_isha: During the extreme period, Isha shares its time with Maghrib until Fajr. The period between sunset and Fajr is divided in two: the first part is given to Maghrib and the second to Isha. If Isha is very late and hard to wait for, you may pray Isha a suitable interval after Maghrib.
